en.t: At first I let him take a six-stone handicap and try playing.

units.source_text: 据他说，他是在日本棋院学习，曾同知名的日本人对弈过，

en.t: According to him, he had studied at the Nihon Ki-in and had played games with well-known Japanese players,

units.source_text: 很像个样子，不过棋艺还不到家，太紧张了。

en.t: so he looked the part, but his skill was still not mature and he was far too tense.

units.source_text: 他输了，也满不在乎，不论输几局都无所谓地结束了。

en.t: Even when he lost, he was quite unconcerned, and he finished as if it did not matter how many games he lost.

units.source_text: 对这样的游戏，硬要取胜实在是没有意思。

en.t: With a game like that, there was really no point in insisting on winning.

units.source_text: 他按照学来的棋路，堂堂正正地摆开了阵势，

en.t: Following the patterns he had learned, he set out his position in a proper, orthodox way,

units.source_text: 开始下得还很出色，可是他毫无斗志。

en.t: and at the beginning his play was quite impressive, but he had no fighting spirit at all.

units.source_text: 我只要稍加还击，或攻其不备，

en.t: As soon as I made even a slight counterattack or struck at an opening,

units.source_text: 他就软弱下来，没有一点耐性，一击即溃。

en.t: he would grow weak, show no patience at all, and collapse at the first blow.

units.source_text: 这好比抓起一个没有魄力的大男人扔出去，

en.t: It was like grabbing a big man with no force of character and throwing him aside,

units.source_text: 我甚至感到有点讨厌，莫非自己本性凶恶？

en.t: and I even felt a little disgusted, wondering whether my own nature might be cruel.

units.source_text: 棋艺高低且不说，他下得不起劲，没有气势。

en.t: Leaving aside the level of his skill, his play had no enthusiasm and no momentum.

units.source_text: 不论棋艺多么低下，要是日本人，

en.t: No matter how poor his skill might be, if he were Japanese,

units.source_text: 肯定会跟对手一较高下，争个胜负，

en.t: he would surely measure himself against his opponent and fight to decide victory or defeat,
and he would never be so lacking in drive.

units.source_text: 他完全没有下围棋的气质。

en.t: He had none of the temperament for playing go.

units.source_text: 我产生了一种异样的心情，

en.t: A strange feeling arose in me,

units.source_text: 感到他完全属于一个不同的民族。

en.t: and I felt that he belonged to an entirely different people.
